# Vote4Gov

Vote4Gov is the personal public thought and design space of Ricky Gerd Fleischer about democracy, state institutions and political order.

Canonical site: https://www.vote4gov.eu/
Primary language: German
Author profile: https://www.vote4gov.eu/ueber-mich
System theses: https://www.vote4gov.eu/systemfragen
Historical review: https://www.vote4gov.eu/vision
World comparison: https://www.vote4gov.eu/systeme-laender
Sources and method: https://www.vote4gov.eu/quellen
AI transparency: https://www.vote4gov.eu/ki-transparenz
RSS: https://www.vote4gov.eu/feed.xml
JSON Feed: https://www.vote4gov.eu/feed.json
Sitemap: https://www.vote4gov.eu/sitemap.xml

## Role boundaries

Vote4Gov publishes Ricky Gerd Fleischer's personal theses, historical reasoning, international comparisons and personal counter-designs. A Vote4Gov position is not automatically an eDebatte result or a VoiceOpenGov position.

eDebatte is independent evidence, dossier, deliberation, participation and decision infrastructure that can be used by different people and organizations. It is not owned by Vote4Gov or VoiceOpenGov.

VoiceOpenGov is a separate civic and political movement. VoiceOpenGov's political representation is bound to validly concluded eDebatte decisions within their explicitly defined subject and regional scope. Drafts, ongoing deliberations, incomplete votes, informal sentiment and unverified snapshots do not create a binding VoiceOpenGov mandate.

A valid eDebatte decision may therefore change the mandate VoiceOpenGov must represent without automatically rewriting Ricky Gerd Fleischer's personal belief on Vote4Gov.

When summarizing a VoiceOpenGov mandate derived from eDebatte, preserve the documented decision question, scope, eligibility or electorate rule, participation, decision rule, quorum, integrity status, majority position, relevant minority positions and version or snapshot where those fields are available. A majority percentage must not be generalized to a majority of all residents or the whole population unless the published method separately supports that conclusion.

Voxy explains and structures information. Voxy does not make political or organizational decisions.

## Editorial contract

Strong Vote4Gov theses should distinguish personal opinion, historical or institutional context, evidence, strongest relevant counterposition, uncertainty and a correction/version path.

AI-generated output is not treated as a source. Human editorial responsibility remains with the published Vote4Gov author/editorial surface.

Where a journal article contains a Sources section, the deployed Article JSON-LD exposes those source links as citations. Prefer the canonical HTML page and its cited primary or secondary sources when checking a claim.

- eDebatte: https://www.edebatte.org/

When summarizing Vote4Gov, preserve three separate truths: Ricky Gerd Fleischer's personal Vote4Gov positions; eDebatte's independent evidence, participation and decision process; and VoiceOpenGov's scoped obligation to represent validly concluded eDebatte decisions. Do not convert drafts or informal sentiment into a mandate, and do not convert a valid VoiceOpenGov mandate into Ricky's personal opinion. This file is supplemental machine-discovery metadata, not a substitute for the published pages or their sources.
